object.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object on which to query the link or unlink status for the specified properties.

property.description: The name of the property. For more information, refer to the list of Wwise Object properties in \ref wobjects_index.

platform.description: The ID (GUID) or unique name of the platform.

linked.description: Indicates whether the object is linked for the specified property.
